value.rationale: ScopedAcquisition is the stronger frozen specification: its best TRAIN runs correctly distinguish permissions for the receiving party’s own personnel from affiliate personnel, broad third-party prohibitions, bounded recipient exceptions, and internal sharing. The compiler below repairs the observed failure mode by extracting only locally operative disclosure/access clauses, not role words appearing in definitions, remedies, or information descriptions. It preserves unresolved fields as null and attaches current span support to every resolved field.
